about: Personas (work/42, brief 13): who you are this week, as a role, never a person. An event is for a persona by rule over its own fields (lane, topics, kind, name); the rule is shown so the link is a labelled hypothesis, not a fact. Every event is for 'anyone' unless its page says it is invite-only or for a closed group.

personas.name: Investor
personas.rule: topics or name mention investors, VCs, venture capital, angels, allocators, LPs, family offices or capital ('venture & fundraising' alone is a founder topic)

personas.name: Founder
personas.rule: the business lane (work/10), or topics or name mention founders, startups, pitching, scaleups, seed rounds, accelerators or fundraising

personas.name: Builder
personas.rule: topics or name mention developers, engineering, AI agents, open source, hackathons, DevOps, cloud, UX, design or no-code

personas.name: Corporate
personas.ask: Are you at a corporate or a public body?
personas.rule: topics or name mention enterprise, SaaS, executives, trade agencies, embassies, delegations or IT operations

personas.name: Student
personas.ask: Are you a student or starting out?
personas.rule: topics or name mention students, careers, jobs, talent, learning or a classroom

personas.name: Anyone
personas.rule: every event that is not invite-only
